_: Asset manifest for the Living Archive audio pass. Field meanings:

_fields.id: Asset id matching the AudioManager call site (without .ogg extension).
_fields.category: music | sfx | ambience — picks the output subfolder under tower_game/audio/.
_fields.kind: music_loop | ambient_loop | sfx_oneshot — used by generate_audio.sh to pick generation mode.
_fields.duration_s: Target length in seconds. Music ≈ 60s loop, ambient ≈ 30s loop, sfx ≈ 0.3-1.5s.
_fields.prompt: Plain-language prompt for the generator. Keep the audio direction from tower/20_audio_plan.md (paper, dust, stamps, glassy strings, dry breath; no melodic motifs).

assets.prompt: Slow, sparse, slightly melancholic title theme. Detuned bell pad, very low strings, distant page-rustle texture. No drums, no melody, just mood. Quiet bureaucratic-archive horror, contemplative. Loopable.
Quiet ambient bed for a map screen. Soft creaking wood, distant breath, low pad in minor. Less foreground than the title theme. Loopable.
Tense combat loop. Detuned strings holding a low drone, brief glassy bell stabs, occasional paper-flutter texture. No drum kit; subtle pulse only. 90 BPM equivalent. Loopable.
Elite combat loop. Heavier dread than mus_combat_normal: lower drone, sparse low brass, tight metallic stamps. No melody. Loopable.
Boss combat loop. Slow processional with low bell tolls, distant choir whisper, thick paper texture. Threatening but not bombastic. Loopable, fits the Living Archive bureaucratic-horror tone.
Campfire loop. Crackling wax candle ambience under a slow, warm low pad in minor. Felt-piano single notes far away, very sparse. Restful, sad. Loopable.
Sparse loop of an old archive room: distant page rustle, slow dust motes, far-off breath, very subtle wood creak. Mono. Loopable, no spike.
Loop of a burnt pile of paper: low ember crackle, slow ash settle, occasional ember pop. Mono. Loopable.
